issue.title: resolve v1.21 breaks bundled graceful-fs in nextjs
issue.body:
As debugged in https://github.com/browserify/resolve/issues/264, `resolve` v1.21 introduces a change in behaviour which in turn breaks `graceful-fs`. A fix in `graceful-fs` is released with v4.2.9, but nft seems to be bundling a lower version. 

As this potentially breaks a lot of `next.js` babel-setups (see f.e. https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/33003), a rerelease with the fixed `graceful-fs`-package would be great!

issue.title: Bump `@vercel/nft` to 0.17.2
issue.body:
This bumps `@vercel/nft` to the latest version and consequently bumps `graceful-fs` to the latest version.

- Fixes #33003
- Related to https://github.com/vercel/nft/pull/258
- Related to https://github.com/browserify/resolve/issues/264
